relationships.subject: PPARα
relationships.evidence_quote: activation of PPARα prevented chronic constriction injury (CCI)-induced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia

relationships.subject: PPARα
relationships.evidence_quote: PPARα ameliorated inflammatory cell infiltration at the injury site and decreased microglial activation, NOD-like receptor protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome production

key_findings: PPARα activation prevented CCI-induced allodynia and reduced microglial activation and NLRP3 inflammasome production.
PPARα antagonists eliminated the analgesic effect of PPARα agonists.
